title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: compliance sensitivity labels for custom connectors
notes: claim 48: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: Hold: the risk rationale says connector content is not label-protected today, although the cited beta reference says the service applies Purview label rules to indexed items. The roadmap facts, licensing background and Graph calls are supported, but the claim that administrators cannot see label-GUID errors is not established.
